channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: Matthew Lillard Opens Up About Quentin Tarantino Slam: “It Felt Like I Had Died”
item.description: The 'Scream 7' actor details his emotional roller coaster in the wake of the director's criticism and how it felt like getting "punched in the mouth."

item.title: How to Get Sold-Out BTS World Tour Tickets
item.description: Here's how fans can still secure seats to see the K-pop supergroup live — and at a discount — with THR-exclusive promo codes.

item.title: NAACP Image Awards: Michelle Obama, Will Packer and Kendrick Lamar’s Super Bowl Halftime Show Among Night One Non-Televised Winners
item.description: The awards, spanning the literary, short-form and creator categories, were announced during a virtual show exclusively on YouTube.

item.title: ‘Awards Chatter’ Pod: Jessie Buckley on Her Presumptive Oscar Turn in ‘Hamnet’ and Maggie Gyllenhaal’s Upcoming ‘The Bride!’
item.description: The 36-year-old Irishwoman also discusses how she was shaped by Dame Judi Dench, the use of dreams in her acting, and the ambivalence of being in the public eye, at times wishing "the ground would swallow me up."

item.title: L.A.’s Graffiti Towers Finds Buyer in $470 Million Deal
item.description: The plan is to finish the project — and clean up the graffiti — before the 2028 Olympic Games.

item.title: Isaac Hayes’ Estate Reaches Settlement With Trump for Unauthorized Use of “Hold on, I’m Coming”
item.description: The late soul icon's family said they "are satisfied with the outcome" of the settlement following the legal battle with the president.

item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ Named Best Film of 2025 by Vancouver Film Critics Circle
item.description: Ryan Coogler also picked up the best director and best screenplay awards for his slick vampire film ‘Sinners,' another Oscars front runner.

item.title: For the Tourette Syndrome Community, the BAFTAs Brought on a Familiar Dread-Like Feeling
item.description: The John Davidson moment cast a light on what advocates say is a condition too little understood — and on the people who don’t understand.

item.title: China Box Office: Lunar New Year Sales Fall 38 Percent From 2025 as ‘Pegasus 3’ Leads Soft Holiday
item.description: Car-racing sequel 'Pegasus 3' earned $369.3 million over its first six days, while Zhang Yimou's 'Scare Out' opened to $110.7 million — huge totals in most markets, but modest for Chinese New Year.
